high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a balcony at night, overlooking a cityscape with illuminated buildings and a body of water reflecting the lights. The individual is wearing a strapless dress that transitions from a sheer, light gray fabric at the top to a solid black fabric at the bottom. The dress fits closely to the body, accentuating the figure. The person has curly hair styled in loose waves and is accessorized with pearl earrings and a delicate necklace. They are also wearing sheer stockings.
